title: Between the Lines: Seeing what others can’t
summary: How Gridware’s Active Grid Response helps utilities detect, understand, and precisely locate grid hazards by turning physical and electrical signals into actionable awareness.
body_markdown:
The electric grid is full of signals.


A subtle vibration. A change in current. The sound of equipment behaving differently. A pole beginning to tilt. A branch making contact with a conductor.


Individually, these moments can be easy to miss. But, when examined, they can reveal something important about what’s happening on the grid and what might happen next.


At Gridware, we call this seeing **between the lines** .


It means looking beyond poles, wires, and equipment to understand the physical and electrical events unfolding across the distribution grid. Connecting signals to context. Distinguishing everyday activity from something that requires attention. And identifying where an event is happening so utilities can make better-informed decisions about what to do next.


That’s the idea behind[Active Grid Response](https://www.gridware.io/active-grid-response) .


By continuously measuring physical, electrical, and environmental conditions, Gridware helps utilities detect, understand, and precisely locate hazards and turning signals from the grid into actionable awareness.


Because seeing the grid is one thing.


**Understanding what’s happening between the lines can change what happens next.**
